artboards.title: Option · search by what they draw

annotations.text:
Artist for Diffusion (Anima) - v5, 2026-09-16
Phase 1 is search only; the catalog moved to the second page.
- Artist is its own card with slots, built like Characters (trigger + weight + / -)
- A slot holds one artist, picked from this modal
- Diffusion only; the card is hidden on Checkpoint and its slots are kept
- 1 slot by default, 3 max
- Slots store plain names; generation writes @name, weight as (@name:0.8)
- New: the picker shows what an artist draws, from a prebuilt profile file

Where the profile comes from
The shipped co-occurrence dictionary has no artist tags at all - its source CSV only carries general, copyright and character tags. So scripts/buildArtistProfiles.mjs asks danbooru's related_tag endpoint twice per artist and writes data/artist_profiles.txt: the general tags the artist uses far more than the site average, plus the series. No API key, resumable, and nothing is fetched at run time.
Built 2026-09-16 for the 1 779 artists above 500 posts. The 17 716 above 100 posts are a later, slower run.

Postponed 2026-09-16. Build after search ships.
One probe prompt x every candidate, same seed, 768x1024 / 20 steps, no Hires, local only. Thumbs saved per model as <model>_artist_thumbs.json and reused as slot and picker thumbs. Open questions: what happens when the probe prompt changes, real time per image, whether the pod may run it.
